results.title: Billing v2 flags honour their district list (shop PIN 411005 → MH-PUN)
results.detail: 11.21-11.23 IST. Flags billing_v2, tcs_engine, tds_engine, delivery_9_5, tally_connector on for [KA-MYS] only: as the Pune shop's owner GET accounts/pos/items, documents, sync, statements/tax, gst-registration, reports/mtr, sales/<S2627-00002>/receipt → 404 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE; /shop/accounts/pos, /documents, /journals, /statements, /sync → redirect to /shop/accounts, /gst/returns → /shop/accounts/gst; desktop + phone: no billing tiles on /shop/accounts, no 'TCS, TDS & wallet statements' in the Finance menu, no 'UPI id for receipts' field, no Counter POS link, no 80 mm/JSON/WhatsApp links, no billing reports. Same flags on [MH-PUN]: all 7 APIs 200, all 6 pages served, tiles, menu item, field, links and reports present.
results.test: D-110 Billing v2 flags honour their district list (shop PIN 411005 → MH-PUN)

results.title: Tally / books export of an unregistered shop is not blocked by HSN / GST rate
results.detail: 11.23-11.24 IST. tally_connector + billing_v2 on MH-PUN; shop UNREGISTERED. GET sync/fixes 2026-11-01..02 → 0 fixes (was 254). Accounts → Sync, Tally card 'Send to software' downloads gokesari-tally-2026-11-01-to-2026-11-02.zip (gokesari-tally.xml 56756 B, .xlsx, mapping .tsf); API export 200 application/zip. XML parses: 6 vouchers each balancing to 0.00 — Sales S2627-00002, -00003, -00004, BKS-000021/2026-27/000019; 2 journals of DB-20261101-4NGI5U.
results.test: D-111 Tally / books export of an unregistered shop is not blocked by HSN / GST rate

results.title: The customer sees and downloads GoKesari's s.9(5) delivery-fee invoice
results.detail: 11.25-11.33 IST and 11.40 IST. Customer /orders/c12200f8… (desktop + phone): 'Bill of supply' and 'Delivery fee invoice (GoKesari)' → /api/delivery-invoices/5e877766…/pdf; click downloads GKS_2627_000001.pdf; GET → 200 application/pdf, 'TAX INVOICE Invoice no: GKS/2627/000001'. One role at a time 25 s apart: customer2 404 (and its /orders/<id> page 404, no link), signed out 401 'Sign in to download this invoice.', shop owner 404, operations 200 (by design). DB-20261101-4NGI5U is no longer among the customer's latest 50 orders, so My orders cannot list it; new order DB-20261102-ERAAO8: My orders (past, page 1) and its order page show 'Bill of supply' + 'Delivery fee invoice (GoKesari)' → GKS/2627/000002, 200. Note: same-second probes first got 404 for every role — a CDN-cached copy of customer2's 404 (logged as D-118).
results.test: D-112 The customer sees and downloads GoKesari's s.9(5) delivery-fee invoice

results.title: Counter bills of a shop with no GSTIN are bills of supply everywhere
results.detail: 11.26-11.27 IST. S2627-00001 (cancelled), -00002, -00003, -00004: page heading and article label 'Bill of supply' on desktop and phone, no 'Tax invoice' on the page; A4 PDF 'BILL OF SUPPLY' ('BILL OF SUPPLY  (CANCELLED)' for -00001); 80 mm receipt 'BILL OF SUPPLY'. MTR (API and screen) rows for S2627-00002..00004 and BKS-000021/2026-27/000019: 'Bill of supply'. Customer's link for DB-20261101-4NGI5U (order page) and DB-20261102-ERAAO8 (order page, My orders): 'Bill of supply'.
results.test: D-113 Counter bills of a shop with no GSTIN are bills of supply everywhere

results.title: The shop sets the UPI id for receipts in Accounts → Settings
results.detail: 11.34-11.35 IST. 'UPI id for receipts' field shown (desktop + phone) while billing_v2 covers MH-PUN (absent under KA-MYS, D-110). Typed testsuccess@gocash (Cashfree sandbox VPA) + 'Save settings' → 'Saved.', API upiVpa testsuccess@gocash; 80 mm receipt S2627-00002 1519 B → 7567 B with a QR decoding to upi://pay?pa=testsuccess%40gocash&pn=E2E%20Four%20Features%20Bakery&am=40.00&cu=INR&tn=Invoice%20S2627-00002, caption 'Pay Rs.40.00 by UPI'. Cleared in the same form + Save → API upiVpa null.
results.test: D-114 The shop sets the UPI id for receipts in Accounts → Settings

results.title: 80 mm receipt, JSON and WhatsApp share on the counter bill and order invoice pages
results.detail: 11.34-11.35 IST, 11.39 IST. Counter bill S2627-00002: '80 mm receipt' 200 application/pdf, 'JSON' 200 application/json, 'Share on WhatsApp' https://wa.me/?text=… 'Bill of supply S2627-00002 from E2E Four Features Bakery, 2026-11-01: ₹40.00. Pay by UPI to testsuccess@gocash.'; on the phone all 3 links, no sideways scroll (412/412). Cancelled S2627-00001: receipt + JSON (200), no WhatsApp. Customer /invoices/<BKS-000021…019> (desktop + phone): '80 mm receipt' 200 PDF, 'JSON' 200, 'Share on WhatsApp' wa.me text 'Bill of supply BKS-000021/2026-27/000019 from E2E Four Features Bakery for order DB-20261101-4NGI5U: ₹60.00.'; the new invoice BKS-000021/2026-27/000020 has the same links. wa.me itself was not opened (WhatsApp's site).

results.title: New order's bill of supply has no s.52 TCS clause and no 'Prices are inclusive of GST'
results.detail: 11.36-11.39 IST. New ONLINE order DB-20261102-ERAAO8 (₹85, Butter Cookies) paid on the app's sandbox page 'Pay (success)' (method UPI, no details entered), accepted, packed, delivered by customer2 at 11.38 IST. Its bill of supply BKS-000021/2026-27/000020: A4 PDF, 80 mm and JSON — no 'collects tax at source under section 52', no 'Prices are inclusive of GST'; ECO note now 'Supplied through the electronic commerce operator TEST ONLY - GoKesari staging (GSTIN 27AAAAA0000A1Z5).'; invoice page the same. BKS-000021/…/000019 keeps the old notes (snapshot at issue, by design). Remaining 'Invoice total (inclusive of tax)' / 'Total (tax inclusive)' label logged separately as D-119.
results.test: D-116 New order's bill of supply has no s.52 TCS clause and no 'Prices are inclusive of GST'

results.title: Invoice of an ONLINE order says 'online payment'
results.detail: 11.39-11.40 IST. DB-20261101-4NGI5U (BKS-000021/…/000019, rendered now): A4 PDF 'Paid by customer (online payment) Rs. 85.00', invoice page 'Paid by the customer (online payment): ₹85.00' (desktop + phone); no 'GoKesari wallet'. New DB-20261102-ERAAO8 (…/000020): the same. The 80 mm order receipt prints no payment line.
results.test: D-117 Invoice of an ONLINE order says 'online payment'

results.title: Hostinger CDN serves an API route's 404 to other sessions (no Cache-Control on error answers)
results.detail: New 11.26-11.33 IST. /api/delivery-invoices/<id>/pdf: customer 200 (private, no-store, x-hcdn-cache-status DYNAMIC) → customer2 404 'Invoice not found.' (no Cache-Control) → customer 404 age=0, signed-out 404 age=0 (route answers 401) — for about 10-20 s. Same on /api/invoices/<id>/json and /pdf. 200 JSON answers are DYNAMIC; 401 and 403 answers were not reused.
results.test: D-118 Hostinger CDN serves an API route's 404 to other sessions (no Cache-Control on error answers)

results.title: Bill of supply labels its total 'inclusive of tax' and lists CGST / SGST rows
results.detail: New 11.39 IST. BKS-000021/2026-27/000020 (seller not GST-registered; note 'Bill of supply: no GST is charged.'): A4 PDF 'Invoice total (inclusive of tax) Rs. 60.00' with CGST Rs. 0.00 / SGST Rs. 0.00 rows and 'Supply: Intra-state (CGST + SGST)'; invoice page 'Total (tax inclusive)'. D-116's expected result: no GST-inclusive wording on a bill of supply.
results.test: D-119 Bill of supply labels its total 'inclusive of tax' and lists CGST / SGST rows
